title: Web frontend tests (web/ npm)
answers: How do I run the web frontend tests?
What does npm test do in mitmproxy web?
body:
- Frontend in `web/`; CI (`.github/workflows/main.yml`) runs `npm ci` then `npm test`.
- `web/package.json` `test` script = `eslint . && tsc --noEmit && jest --coverage`.
- Run: `cd web && npm ci && npm test`. Single file (inferred, not verified): `npx jest path/to/file.test.tsx`.
- Jest config in `web/jest.config.js`, setup files `web/setup-jest.js`, `web/setup-global-jest.js`; jsdom, @testing-library/react, jest-fetch-mock.
- Lint/type/format: ESLint (`web/eslint.config.mjs`), tsc (`web/tsconfig.json`), prettier (`npm run prettier`, `npm run eslint` write changes). Dev server: `npm start` (vite).
